assign.request: the id shouldn't be in the card preview on the left (relayed by task-mastermind-ai2-dashboard for the Live card's preview line)

decision.msg: The Live preview ends with the last reply (a sentence written for you) instead of the last update line ('<agent-id> finished a turn'), and says how many agents are working. Alternative: map ids to group names — rejected, an update line has nothing to say beyond the id.

assign.outcome: **The Live card's preview no longer shows a raw agent id** — merged into michael/dev (branch worktree/live-preview, merge commit 347140a2). It now reads like "18 running (3 working) · 4 tasks · <the last reply>". Checked headless on the live site: no console errors.
